_note: The Martial Artist (the user's of 2026-10-28): her chi attacks (the user's table of 2026-10-28, revised the same day: damage, mana, tier; two to start, two more for each tier boss she slays), her fists, her hero's card. Read by pipeline/unreal/872 (mistward_castle and martial_arts). chi: clip = martialartist_clips.py's; each strikes as a bolt that flies chi_range cm at most from the striking hand or foot, unseen unless it has a bolt effect (the user's of 2026-10-29: the looks are on her fists and legs, only the Piercing Palm's rods fly). look: effects on her body while the move plays (FRDLimbFx), each on every bone listed: from / to = seconds of the clip it follows the bone (turned as she faces), then fades life s and is destroyed; at = one-shots left where the bone is at those times, destroyed after life s; scale = the pack's User.Scale (user_scale false: the component's). bolt / hit: the flying effect and the burst on the monster. Paths: MP4/ MP5/ = Magic Projectiles Vol 4 / 5, SL/ = Stylized Slashes V2, SH/ = Stylized Shields, TE1/ = Toon Explosion Vol 1, LD/ = Loot Drops V2 (their Particles/NiagaraSystems folders). hit_life: the hit destroyed this long after it began (s; none: 2; the Piercing Palm's rod hung in the air 1.5 s, the user saw it). splash (cm) by tier: the burst's reach round the monster it strikes (others there take half).

chi.name: Smashing Strike
chi.effect: Chi: both fists brought down from overhead, wrapped in fire

chi.name: Roundhouse Kick
chi.effect: Chi: the shin whipped round at waist height, trailing thick smoke

chi.name: Chain Punch
chi.effect: Chi: a flurry of straight punches, sparks of light at each one, the last the strongest

chi.name: Rear Kick
chi.effect: Chi: a half turn away and the leg driven straight back, glowing rings round it

chi.name: Piercing Palm
chi.effect: Chi: a lunging spear-hand thrust; glowing rods fly from her hands

chi.name: Axe Kick
chi.effect: Chi: the straight leg swung up past her head and chopped down; fireworks burst from the kick

chi.name: Meteor Fist
chi.effect: Chi: she leaps and drives her fist down like a falling star, a fireball on it

chi.name: Spinning Kick
chi.effect: Chi: a full turn on one foot and a sweeping kick, chain lightning all along the leg
